Blocnet Level Badges

Blocnet · 15-level progression

Level badges

Two versions to compare. Version 1 is your original sheet, cut into transparent icons. Version 2 is a redesign built as a system: five tiers, one colour and one frame shape per tier, and pips that count the step within the tier. Switch your system theme to check both on the other ground.

How the system reads

Colour and shape say the tier

Iron circle, Jade hexagon, Amethyst shield, Gold octagon, Ruby seal. Even at 16px the silhouette and hue tell you roughly where someone stands.

The motif says the level

Each level keeps its own symbol from your sheet, so Champion is still a crown and Legend is still a flame.

Pips count the step

One, two or three dots under the motif mark the first, second or third level in a tier.

The ladder by tier

IronLevels 1–3 · Circle

Getting started. Your first weeks on Blocnet.

JadeLevels 4–6 · Hexagon

Active members who contribute, build and advocate.

AmethystLevels 7–9 · Shield

Veterans with real standing in the community.

GoldLevels 10–12 · Octagon

Experts trusted to guide and guard the network.

RubyLevels 13–15 · Seal

The rarest tier. Legends, titans and pioneers.
